test.edgeHint: Choose a surah, or draw from your memorized hizbs. Random tests only include passages entirely within your completed hizbs.
test.edgeCountHint: Choose how many opening or ending ayahs to test. Short surahs use all their ayahs.
test.noEdges: No complete opening or ending of this length is within your completed hizbs. Choose a surah or reduce the count.
test.reciteOpening: Recite the opening ayahs from memory, then reveal them to check.
test.reciteEnding: Recite the final ayahs from memory, then reveal them to check.
test.hiddenPrompt: Recall the passage yourself. Reveal one ayah if you need a hint.
test.spanSurahsHint: On: continue across surahs within your selected or memorized range. Off: stop at the end of the starting surah, even if fewer ayahs remain. Applies to the next test.
test.localSave: Test length and revision starts are saved on this device for your account and riwayah.
test.storageError: Device storage is unavailable. Your settings and revision list may not survive a reload.
test.exhausted: You have tried every starting ayah in this range. Start a new session to repeat them.
test.title: Random start test
test.description: Test how well you can continue from a random ayah in your memorized hizbs, or choose your own range.
test.customHint: Choose any range to test, independently of your memorization map.
test.marked: Draws from your {count} memorized ayahs using your preferred riwayah.
test.empty: Set up your memorization record, confirm a practice range, or choose a custom range to begin.
test.invalid: Choose a valid range with its end after or at its start.
test.error: Could not load the test. Please try again.
test.recite: Read this ayah, then continue from memory.
test.continuationHint: Choose 1–30 additional ayahs. The option below controls whether to continue into the next surah.
test.rangeEnd: The surah or allowed section ends before the requested count is reached.
test.checkHint: Reveal the following ayahs to check yourself. This does not change your saved progress.
test.end: This is the last ayah of the surah or allowed section. Try another start.

Memorization.title: Memorization progress
Memorization.description: Set your starting record, build your memorization through practice, and test your recall.

dashboard.title: {completed}/60 hizbs completed
dashboard.description: Your whole-Quran memorization goal, one hizb at a time.

Memorization.progressTitle: {completed, plural, one {One hizb secured} other {# hizbs secured}}
Memorization.progressDescription: {remaining, plural, one {One hizb remains. Keep going gently and consistently.} other {# hizbs remain. Every completed hizb is a meaningful step forward.}}
Memorization.completeDescription: All 60 hizbs are recorded. Keep revising to strengthen your recall.
Memorization.personalRecord: After setup, your map fills from ranges you confirm from memory and successful circle reviews. Reading or listening alone does not add memorization.
Memorization.mapDescription: Open a hizb to see its progress, history, and practice options.
Memorization.reopenHizb: Mark Hizb {number} as needing more work
Memorization.markedInProgress: Hizb {number} is open for more work.
Memorization.updateFailed: We could not update your memorization progress.

record.automatic: After setup, your map fills from ranges you confirm from memory and successful circle reviews. Reading or listening alone does not add memorization.
record.setupHint: Add the surahs or ayahs you had memorized before starting this record. You can also select whole hizbs. Review your selection before saving; you can correct it later.
record.correctHint: Correct the surahs, ayahs, or whole hizbs you knew when you started this record. Review your changes before saving. Each correction is kept in your history.
record.selected: {count, plural, one {# hizb selected} other {# hizbs selected}}
record.saved: Your starting record has been saved.
record.stale: Your starting record changed in another session. Load the latest selection to replace this draft before continuing.
record.selectHint: Choose the hizbs you had memorized before starting this record. Each juz contains two hizbs.
record.gridHint: Open a hizb to see its progress, history, and practice options.
record.sources: Starting record: {baseline} ayahs · Personal confirmation: {self} · Circle review: {peer}. Sources can overlap; each ayah counts once.
record.noAssessments: No confirmed practice or circle reviews for this hizb yet.
record.confirmSetupHint: Check your selections below. Your map will show partial hizbs as well as complete ones. Confirmed practice and circle reviews are also included.
record.confirmCorrectionHint: Save your corrected starting record. Confirmed practice and circle reviews remain saved. You can make another correction whenever needed.
record.editHint: Record whole surahs, individual ayah ranges, or complete hizbs. You can correct your starting memorization at any time.
record.preservedProgress: Ayahs covered by another selection, confirmed practice, or circle reviews remain memorized on your map, even when you remove this starting selection.
record.passagesHint: Choose a surah, then add the whole surah or just the ayahs you know. Add as many passages as you need before reviewing your selection.
record.validAyahs: Choose ayahs from 1 to {count}, with the end at or after the start.
record.passageAdded: Added to your selection. Review and save when you are ready.
record.alreadySelected: These ayahs are already in your passage selection.
record.noPassages: No surahs or ayah ranges added yet.
record.overlapHint: Overlapping surahs, ayah ranges, and hizbs count only once. Removing one selection keeps any ayahs covered by your other selections.
record.selectionSummary: {hizbs, plural, one {# whole hizb} other {# whole hizbs}} · {passages, plural, one {# passage} other {# passages}}
record.revisionSync: Your unfinished revision sessions will update to match your corrected memorization. Completed revision and progress on unchanged passages are kept.

admin.title: Previous correction requests
admin.description: These requests are kept for reference. Learners now correct their starting record directly from their memorization map; no approval is needed.

personal.title: Record memorization from your own practice
personal.hint: Hide the text and recite this whole range from memory, then check it. Reach the last ayah and confirm below when you can recite it accurately. No circle membership is needed.
personal.confirm: I recited this range from memory
personal.confirmDescription: Confirm that you recited the entire practice range from memory and checked it. This will add the range to your map as a personal confirmation.
personal.completedHint: This range has been added to your map as a personal confirmation. Overlapping ayahs count only once.
personal.failed: Could not confirm this range. Make sure your progress has reached its last ayah, then try again.

weekly.title: Weekly revision
weekly.cardDescription: Choose your revision days and pace. Get an optional weekly plan from the passages you have memorized.
weekly.intro: An optional plan built from your memorized ayahs, including partial surahs and hizbs. Rotate through familiar passages, with space for those that need more practice.
weekly.setupRequired: Save your starting memorization record before enabling a revision plan.
weekly.pauseHint: Your saved sessions and results are kept. Resume whenever you are ready.
weekly.stableWeek: Unfinished portions move to your next selected study day without increasing your daily amount. Corrections to your memorization automatically update affected sessions, keeping completed revision and progress on unchanged passages.
weekly.noMemorization: Add a memorized surah or ayah range to your starting record, or confirm a practice range, to generate a revision plan.
weekly.reminderHint: Reminders require notifications enabled on this device. Changes take effect immediately in the current schedule’s time zone. Completed days are skipped.
weekly.previewHint: Preview before saving. New amounts and readings apply after the current portions are finished. Saved study-day changes reschedule unfinished portions immediately. Reminder changes take effect immediately in the current schedule’s time zone.
weekly.pool: Based on {count, plural, one {# completed hizb} other {# completed hizbs}}.
weekly.noDaysLeft: No sessions remain to schedule this week. Your next week is generated automatically on your selected days.
weekly.capacityHint: Each passage appears once in a schedule. Missed portions carry forward at the same pace, even into a later week. The dates shown depend on finishing your current portions as planned.
weekly.failed: Could not save the change. Refresh the page and try again.
weekly.invalid: Check the selected days, time zone and reminder time.
weekly.stale: Your record or plan changed. Preview it again before saving.
weekly.removed: This passage is no longer in your memorization record. Your plan will update to match the passages you still know.
weekly.difficultSaved: Revision recorded. This passage will receive extra attention in future plans.
weekly.peerCredit: {count} of {total} ayahs already reviewed in your circle.
weekly.readerHint: Recite the remaining ayahs from memory, then check them. Ayahs already approved in your circle are omitted. Reach the end before recording how it went. Your progress is saved if you need to stop.
weekly.confirmComfortable: Confirm that you recited the remaining ayahs from memory and checked them. This completes the session.
weekly.confirmDifficult: Record that you finished revising but need more practice. This completes the session and flags the passage for future revision without removing your memorization.
weekly.readerFailed: Could not record this session. Check that it is available today and you have reached the last remaining ayah, then return to Practice.

editor.intro: Choose your amount and reading, then preview the passages before enabling.
editor.chooseDays: Choose at least one revision day.
editor.reminderHint: Optional, at a time that suits you.
editor.limitHint: The actual ranges depend on your memorized hizbs and the days remaining.
editor.previewHint: Preview your ayah ranges, then enable the plan when you’re ready.

weekly.sharedDaysHint: Revision uses the days saved in your study schedule.

rotation.title: Your full revision rotation
rotation.summary: This schedule includes {scheduled} of your {total} memorized ayahs. The remaining {remaining} ayahs are included in the following weeks.
rotation.paceHint: All memorized passages count, including partial hizbs. Your selected study days and daily amount set the pace of the rotation.
rotation.showWeeks: See the next {count, plural, one {week} other {# weeks}}
rotation.forecastHint: Estimated dates assume you finish your current sessions as planned. Missed days, corrections, and review results may change the following weeks. These passages become active when their week is generated.
rotation.pausedHint: This is a forecast. Resume your plan to schedule these passages; dates will adjust to your return.
rotation.chooseDays: Choose revision days to see dates for the remaining passages.
rotation.unscheduledSummary: Your rotation includes all {total} memorized ayahs. Choose revision days to schedule the {remaining} ayahs outside the current schedule.

overview.title: Your memorization
overview.remaining: {count, plural, one {# hizb to go. Keep building at your own pace.} other {# hizbs to go. Keep building at your own pace.}}
overview.setupHint: Choose your starting record below to begin your journey.
overview.revisionHint: Spread your revision across the week, at your own pace.
overview.testHint: Start from a random ayah and continue from memory.
overview.memorizedAyahs: {count, plural, one {# ayah memorized} other {# ayahs memorized}}

learning.title: Weekly memorization
learning.intro: Set a weekly target and memorize it across your saved study days.
learning.scheduleHint: Choose revision and memorization days once. A day can be used for both.
learning.scheduleChanges: Saving days reschedules unfinished portions immediately, keeping passages, completed work and reading positions. Leave a row empty to keep that activity’s unfinished portions without scheduled dates until you choose days again. To change the number or size of sessions too, choose Regenerate plan.
learning.stale: Your plan or progress changed. Refresh the preview and try again.
learning.failed: Unable to save. Please try again.
learning.progressHint: Your plan starts at the first unmemorized passage in your chosen direction and adapts to grid corrections. Unfinished portions carry over within your weekly limit. Only confirmed memorization adds progress.
learning.noDays: Choose and save your days above.
learning.targetHint: {hizbs} hizb per week. 1 = quarter hizb, 2 = half hizb, 4 = one hizb.
learning.forward: From the first hizb toward the last
learning.backward: From the last hizb toward the first
learning.splitHint: Whole ayahs are spread across the remaining study days, skipping memorized ayahs. Each quarter with new memorization confirmed this week uses one weekly slot, including a carried-over portion or new circle-confirmed memorization. New quarters wait when the limit is reached. Amount, direction and reading changes apply to the next schedule.
learning.empty: No passages to schedule for this week: there may be no days left, or the passages in this direction are already memorized.
learning.confirmHint: Confirm that you have memorized all the ayahs in this passage. This updates your memorization grid.
learning.editorIntro: Choose your weekly amount and direction, then preview your sessions.
learning.sessionHint: Learn this passage, then confirm your memorization in the reader.
learning.scheduleStale: Your study days changed elsewhere. Review the latest selection and save again.
learning.editorSummaryHint: Your grid chooses the starting passage. Every surah progresses from beginning to end, even when it crosses hizb boundaries.
learning.readerHint: Learn the whole passage, hide the text and recite it from memory, then check it. Reach the last ayah before confirming your memorization.
learning.coveredHint: This passage is included in your memorized progress. Overlapping ayahs count only once.
learning.automaticStartHint: Each surah is learned from its first unmemorized ayah to its end. If a hizb begins mid-surah, the plan includes its earlier unmemorized ayahs first. Longer surahs continue across weeks within your weekly amount. Grid corrections update unfinished sessions automatically.

plans.setupHint: Review and save your starting record before enabling either weekly plan.
plans.pauseHint: Your sessions and results are kept. Resume when you are ready.
plans.pauseSaved: Plan paused. Your progress is kept.
plans.chooseDays: Choose and save at least one day for this activity above.
plans.changesHint: Preview before saving. These settings apply after the current portions are finished. Saving study days above moves existing portions without changing their number. Choose Regenerate plan to rebuild sessions using your new days and amount.
plans.previewHint: Check your dates and passages in the preview, then enable your plan.
plans.failed: Could not save the change. Please try again.
plans.invalid: Check the study days, amount, reading and time zone, then try again.
plans.stale: Your plan or progress changed. Preview again before saving.
plans.noStudyDays: No study days are saved for this activity. Choose days above to schedule your unfinished portions.
plans.regenerateHint: Rebuild sessions using the days and settings shown here, starting on the next available study day. This replaces the saved schedule and resets unfinished reading positions. Recorded memorization and review results are kept. A paused plan stays paused.
plans.regenerateCount: {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} across {days, plural, one {# study day} other {# study days}}. Only remaining days in the starting week are used; the amount of available material can limit the number of sessions.
plans.deleteHint: This permanently removes this plan’s settings, scheduled sessions and unfinished reading positions. Your recorded memorization, completed review results, saved study days and other plan are kept. You can create a new plan later.
plans.deleted: Plan deleted. Your recorded progress is kept.
plans.deleteStale: This plan changed while the confirmation was open. Close this dialog, review the updated plan and try again.
plans.sessionsHint: Open today’s highlighted session to practice.

retention.followUpsHint: Revisit new passages within your revision plan.
retention.notebookHint: Remember difficult ayahs and practise them.
retention.similarHint: Recall the continuation and compare familiar ayahs.
retention.reportHint: See your learning, reviews and next steps.
retention.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
retention.stale: This entry changed on another screen. Reload it before trying again.
retention.reviewerHint: Optional: record exact ayahs in the learner’s notebook. These are saved with your review.
retention.connectingDescription: Recite these familiar ayahs, then continue into today’s passage below. This warm-up does not add new memorization credit.
retention.notebookDescription: Keep exact ayahs that need attention. Practise recurring difficulties and mark them resolved when you are ready.
retention.emptyNotebookHint: Add an entry here or use “Record a difficulty” beside an ayah in your practice reader.
retention.occurrences: Recorded {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
retention.practisedCount: Practised {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
retention.notMemorized: This ayah is not currently in your memorization grid. Add it when learned to enable focused practice.
retention.focusedDescription: Recall the difficult ayah and continue through the familiar ayahs shown after it. Finishing records practice only; it does not change your memorization grid or complete a planned review.
retention.recallPrompt: Recite the continuation from memory before revealing the text.
retention.similarDescription: Start from an opening, recall the continuation, then compare similar ayahs from your memorization. Text and numbering follow your selected reading.
retention.noSimilarKnown: No matching similar ayahs are fully memorized yet. Try another ayah.
retention.gridChanged: Your memorization has changed. Reload this page to choose a current passage.
retention.studyUnavailable: Similar-ayah content is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
retention.noSimilarCandidates: No supported similar-ayah exercises are available in your memorization yet. They appear as your grid grows.
retention.highlightHint: Highlighted words differ from the prompt ayah. Compare the complete wording carefully.
retention.reportDescription: A view of your recorded memorization, revision and focused practice.
retention.reportCountHint: Ayah totals count complete ayahs once in the displayed reading. Grid corrections are not new learning, and repeated reviews do not inflate coverage.
retention.openHint: Open counts show portions originally scheduled that week which are still unfinished now.
retention.noDifficulties: No mistakes were added to the notebook this week.
retention.adjustHint: {count, plural, one {# portion from this week is still open} other {# portions from this week are still open}}. Consider a smaller weekly amount or adjust your study days to fit your routine.
retention.steadyHint: Keep the amount that fits your routine, and use your notebook for passages that need extra attention.
retention.followUpCount: Currently consolidating {count, plural, one {# ayah} other {# ayahs}}
retention.revisionPaused: Revision is paused or not set up. Enable it to schedule consolidation reviews.
retention.learningPaused: Memorization is paused or not set up.
retention.followUpDescription: New memorization returns on an available revision day after 1 day, then 3 and 7 days after successful reviews. Difficult reviews return sooner. These use your daily allowance; unstarted portions may adapt while regular rotation continues.
